info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Card Merchant Relation-spec
info.description: The Card Merchant Relationship Management API enables businesses to establish and manage relationships between payment cards and merchants. This API facilitates the integration of card data with merchant profiles, allowing for streamlined transaction processing and improved customer experiences. Typical consumers include financial institutions, payment processors, and developers working on e-commerce solutions. With this API, users can effectively create and manage associations, ensuring that transactions are accurately attributed to the correct merchants.

post.summary: Create a new merchant relation for a card
post.description: This operation allows clients to establish a new relationship between a card and a merchant, facilitating various payment and transaction features.
